style.rule: Use a consistent Lucide line style. Emoji are content decoration only and never core navigation or action icons.

rtl.labelAndIcon: Place the icon before its label in document order so it appears on the RTL-leading side.
rtl.directional: Use direction-aware back/forward icons rather than mirroring unrelated symbols.

semanticColorRule: Inherit text color by default. Use semantic color only to convey a real semantic state, with a text label or accessible name.
